given.note: STATE note 38's crash: mark-a7-03-delivered-by-key committed A7-03's first delivery, and the dispatcher went down before it handed that answer to the clock arming, so no armClock ran (arm-clock-a7-03-after-4006 never happened in this chain) and the gateway never answered Linq. Linq sends the words' receipt again (arch 02 line 109: 'Write fails: 503, and the provider retries'), the same event: the same message id, time and echoed key. The part now holds that message id, so it is found by it; it is already delivered, so the mark is a repeat and nothing is written, and the row stays sending at version 5 with the poll pending. firstDelivery stays false, as every repeat answers it. repeatedDelivery names what it repeats: no other part try of the row holds a delivered_at, so it was the row's first delivery, at 14:05:04Z as stored. The caller hands it to the clock arming as a first delivery from that time, whose armClock request is arm-clock-a7-03-after-4006's: the arming the crash lost.
